headline: Blue Origin’s next launch now won’t happen until 2027
summary: Blue Origin's New Glenn rocket launch is delayed to January 2027. This new timeline follows a May launchpad explosion. The explosion caused damage to the New Glenn launchpad.

headline: Samsung’s Galaxy Z Fold 8 is $300 off ahead of Black Friday
summary: The Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 8 is now $300 off at Amazon and Best Buy. It's discounted to $1,599.99, close to its lowest price ever. This significant saving comes just months after the device's launch.

headline: Muse has a voice mode now
summary: Meta has introduced a real-time voice conversation mode for its Muse AI agent. Mark Zuckerberg announced the new feature. Users can now chat verbally with their Muse AI avatar.

headline: EA is bringing 25 classic PC games to Steam
summary: EA is releasing 25 classic PC games on Steam. Titles include "Anniversary Editions" of Road Rash and Wing Commander series. These editions offer modern system support while preserving original gameplay.

headline: G2 Esports Parts Ways With Head Coach Luka 'Perkz' Perković After His 'Tweet Bomb' Sparks Backlash
summary: G2 Esports has fired its head coach, Luka "Perkz" Perković. The decision follows divisive comments made by Perković on Twitter/X. His "tweet bomb" caused significant backlash.

headline: There's a 'Fifty-Fifty' Chance Godzilla Minus Zero Director Takashi Yamazaki Would Make a Godzilla Threequel
summary: Godzilla Minus Zero director Takashi Yamazaki is unsure about a sequel. He states there's a "fifty-fifty" chance he'd return for a third film. The film's ending leaves room for story continuation, but Yamazaki is split.

headline: Today’s Top Deals: The Blood of Dawnwalker for PS5, Apple AirPods 5, SteelSeries Nova Pro Gaming Headset
summary: Discover today's best deals on gaming and tech products. Featured deals include The Blood of Dawnwalker for PS5 and Apple AirPods 5. Save on accessories like the SteelSeries Nova Pro Gaming Headset and Corsair DDR5 RAM.

headline: It's Official: Marvel Has Finally Undone the Controversial Spider-Man - One More Day Storyline
summary: Marvel Comics has officially reversed the controversial "One More Day" Spider-Man storyline. Fans have waited 20 years for this plot correction. The storyline's undoing addresses a long-standing point of contention.

headline: Russell Brand found guilty of rape and sexual assault
summary: Russell Brand has been found guilty of one count of rape and three sexual assaults. He is told to expect a significant prison sentence. More rape allegations against him can now be reported.

headline: Watch: Met Police release Brand interview footage
summary: The Metropolitan Police have released interview footage of Russell Brand. Brand was found guilty of one rape and three sexual assaults. The verdict was delivered at Southwark Crown Court.

headline: Henry Nowak’s killer has minimum term increased to 25 years by Court of Appeal
summary: Vickrum Digwa's minimum prison term for Henry Nowak's murder was increased. The Court of Appeal raised it to 25 years, ruling the original sentence too lenient. Digwa's attempt to cut his sentence was rejected.

headline: Hoax bomb threats target European airlines and airports for second time in a week
summary: European airlines and airports received hoax bomb threats for the second time in a week. At least 21 flights across Europe were affected by the threats. The UK government has labeled these incidents as "malicious hoax threats."
